case-stereo.title: Case 12: the stereo

config.title: Case file: the stereo next door
config.story: Your neighbour's stereo (associated equipment) buzzes when you transmit. An ISED measurement on their premises found your field strength well below the immunity criteria.
evidence: Your field strength there is below ISED's criteria.
You're operating within your power limits.
It stops when you stop transmitting.
config.caption: Distorted speech from the stereo speakers whenever you transmit.

case-stereo.success: Below the criteria, so under EMCAB-2 the stereo's lack of immunity is the cause. Ferrite and filters on the stereo are the fix, and you can help.

case-tv.title: Case 13: the TV

config.title: Case file: the television
config.story: Another neighbour's TV breaks up when you transmit. This time the measured field strength on their premises is above the immunity criteria.
evidence: Your field strength there is above ISED's criteria.
Your antenna is right beside their house.
config.caption: The TV picture and sound break up every time you transmit.

case-tv.success: Above the criteria, so your transmission is the cause: reduce your field strength there, with less power or a better antenna location.
